The key observable is that Claire doesn't ask Marcus whether he has a preference; she asserts what his preference is and attributes it to something he said before. This implies prior one-on-one knowledge, consistent with the warm-but-asymmetric relationship where Claire pays more attention to Marcus's life than he does to hers.
